tei:div.tei:p: A prayer upon the signing of the Versailles Peace Treaty on 28 June 1919, included in a special service by the Liberal Jewish Synagogue of London on the following Shabbat. The author of the prayer is not indicated but Rabbi Israel Mattuck led the congregation at that time and was the editor of the congregations prayerbooks published in 1923. If you know for certain, please leave a comment or contact us.
